label: D1 reward-received while committed to a2, early in episode (trials ~3-21)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass), and almost exclusively when the agent is in an a2 regime: the previous choice was a2 (where observable) and the upcoming choice is a2 (>99.9% of mass; a1 trials essentially never). It is also confined to early episode time: never on ep_trial 0-2 or >=30, peaking at trials 10-19; consequently it is dominated by low_first episodes (S2 good first, 94% of mass) and by the narrow value band 7.54-7.73 and choice logit -4.4..-1.5. The predicate uses action (the agent upcoming choice, marked FUTURE at D1 but computed by the agent); the observed-only variant with prev_action == 2 has the same precision but loses the rel -3 trials where prev_action is unknown in the window (dev F1 0.54 vs 0.65). Magnitude: largest on the first reward of a run and decays over consecutive rewarded a2 trials (e.g. 1.00, 0.83, 0.72, 0.64). Precision ~0.5: about half of rewarded-a2 D1 steps in this time window stay inactive, which no tested history variable (transition type, good state, value band) resolves, so the unit likely tracks a slowly drifting early-episode hidden state. Does not fire at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1, or late in the episode.
